null_link_perm_core.label: link_permutation_distribution
null_link_perm_core.date_pool: death records, so crowded dates repeat
null_link_perm_core.eligibility_rule: fixed support: each successor's unrelated-date pool is restricted BEFORE drawing to dates on which it was observed on at least one side; support is identical across replicates
null_link_perm_core.excluded_reason: successors without a full-history cache are excluded: a repeated permutation would need one bounded fetch per successor per draw
